answer: Each epoch, keys are randomly paired for a short interactive proof: both must sign a transcript bound to a public cedar root (hash of epoch seed plus pair IDs) and respond within a tight window. Pairings and results hang on a public trellis. If either side is later proven sybil, the paired counterpart's locked shale of collateral slashes too, so honest keys refuse pairs that share their funding or timing fingerprint. A farm of N keys either pairs internally (detectable clique) or must buy N scarce honest counterparties willing to risk their shale.
